subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

The massive exterior wall of the old mansion was being painted by the skilled laborers when it suddenly started raining heavily.

options.text: The skilled laborers were painting the massive exterior wall of the old mansion when it suddenly started raining heavily.
The skilled laborers painted the massive exterior wall of the old mansion when it suddenly started raining heavily.
The skilled laborers are painting the massive exterior wall of the old mansion when it suddenly started raining heavily.
The skilled laborers had been painting the massive exterior wall of the old mansion when it suddenly started raining heavily.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice structure: The subject performs the action on the object.
 
• The first clause of the original sentence is in the **Past Continuous** passive form: *"was being painted"*.
 
• To convert to active voice: Move the agent "the skilled laborers" to the subject position.
 
• Change the passive verb "was being painted" to the active past continuous form "were painting" (matching the plural subject "laborers").
 
• Move the passive subject "The massive exterior wall of the old mansion" to the object position.
 
• The dependent clause "when it suddenly started raining heavily" remains exactly the same.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The skilled laborers were painting the massive exterior wall of the old mansion when it suddenly started raining heavily."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"The skilled laborers painted..." – Incorrect tense (Simple Past instead of Past Continuous).
 
• **Option 3: **"The skilled laborers are painting..." – Incorrect tense (Present Continuous instead of Past Continuous).
 
• **Option 4: **"The skilled laborers had been painting..." – Incorrect tense (Past Perfect Continuous instead of Past Continuous).
